title: Mother's Day Lunch at Pier 10
summary: A winery Mother's Day lunch in Shoreham, the simplest long-table version of the weekend if the brief is one booking and no extra choreography.
description: Pier 10 has a dedicated Mother's Day lunch on Sunday 10 May 2026. In Peninsula terms, this is the tidy vineyard-table version of the day: one destination, one booking, and enough scenery that the afternoon does not need padding.
kidsGradeNote: Works with children, but the point of this booking is the long lunch rather than built-in kids programming.
editorVerdict: The clean vineyard-table Mother's Day booking. Best for people who want the day to feel polished and easy rather than overly programmed.
editorNote: Pier 10 is the Mother's Day option for people who want a proper long lunch without needing a second act. Shoreham is enough of a destination on its own, the winery setting does the visual work, and the correct move is simply to book the table and stop trying to add more Peninsula productivity around it.
